visualCharacteristics.structure: framed box: filter dropdown + slides of 3 image-top cards + dot indicators

contentPattern.structure: Row 1 (optional, 1 cell): filter label 'View Plans by...'. Card rows, 3 cells: [picture (+ optional link to MP4 = play in modal)] | [h3 title, p text or ul, link 'More Details'] | [categories, comma-separated]. Distinct categories become the filter options; a card without categories shows for every filter; 3 cards per slide, dots only, no autoplay
